title: Span and Units of an Authorization Issued on Reconsideration, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when a Medical Necessity Reconsideration or Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration of a denied authorization is decided overturned or decided partially overturned, the authorization is issued with the following span and units.

## Span

- The validity span starts on the first service date under appeal when care was already given, and on the issue date otherwise.
- It runs the authorization type's validity days, counting the first day as day 1; the last day is the first day plus the validity days, less one day.

## Units

The units issued are the lesser of the units requested, the type's units on a standard approval (its default units authorized) and the type's maximum units per authorization. The units issued are never more than the type's maximum units per authorization.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Units requested on the denied request | 40 |
| Type's units on a standard approval | 30 |
| Type's maximum units per authorization | 120 |
| Type's validity days | 60 |
| Care already given under appeal | no; issued on 10 April |

The units issued are the lesser of 40, 30 and 120, that is 30. The span starts on the issue date, 10 April (day 1), and its last day is 8 June (day 60).

## Second example (hypothetical)

Units requested 20 on a type with 30 standard units and 120 maximum, care already given from 2 March, validity days 60: 20 units are issued, and the span runs from 2 March to 30 April.
